title: The 6 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Cats on Diets
h1: The 6 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Cats on Diets
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for automatic pet feeders for cats on diets, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders for cats on diets using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PetSafe Smart Feed Automatic Dog & Cat Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: Portions from 1/8 cup to 4 cups per meal, Up to 12 scheduled meals per day, Slow Feed setting releases food over about 15 minutes.
strengths: 1/8-cup increments allow closer matching to a vet-prescribed portion than half-cup feeders
Slow Feed setting addresses fast eating alongside portion control
Frequent small meals (up to 12/day) can be programmed to reduce begging between feedings
limitations: No mechanism to stop a housemate pet from also eating the diet cat's portion
Auger accuracy can drift with very small kibble or crumbly diet formulas
Requires periodic manual verification against a measuring cup
features: Portions from 1/8 cup to 4 cups per meal
Up to 12 scheduled meals per day
Slow Feed setting releases food over about 15 minutes
App alerts when the hopper is running low

products.name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
products.blurb: Key specs: Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition, Sealed lid prevents access between registered visits, Training mode for gradual lid-opening introduction.
strengths: Guarantees the diet cat's bowl stays off-limits to a food-motivated housemate
Sealed lid also keeps wet prescription food fresher between small meals
3-year warranty reflects durability built for daily long-term use
limitations: Doesn't measure or schedule portions on its own; portioning is still manual per fill
Connect app features need a separately sold hub
Higher price than a standard hopper feeder
features: Microchip and RFID collar tag recognition
Sealed lid prevents access between registered visits
Training mode for gradual lid-opening introduction
Suitable for both wet and dry prescription diets

products.name: Cat Mate C500 Digital 5-Meal Automatic Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 individual pre-portioned compartments, Digital timer with an initial feed plus 4 scheduled meals, Included ice packs keep wet food cold for hours.
strengths: Pre-portioning each of the 5 compartments by hand guarantees exact serving sizes, no auger drift possible
Ice packs make it genuinely usable for a wet-food weight-management diet, not just dry kibble
Lower price than an app-connected feeder for a single diet cat
limitations: Caps out at 5 meals total before it needs refilling and resetting
No app, so there's no remote alert if a meal fails to dispense
features: Digital timer with an initial feed plus 4 scheduled meals
Included ice packs keep wet food cold for hours

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary 5L Automatic Pet Feeder (Button Model)
strengths: No app or Wi-Fi needed; set it on the unit
Up to 6 meals a day with small 20 ml portions for portion control
Runs on D batteries as power backup
Large 5-liter hopper
limitations: Programming via buttons is less intuitive than an app

products.name: Closer Pets 5-Meal Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: Five timed meals for portion control
Works with wet or dry food
Stainless steel bowls
Tamper-resistant lid

products.name: Cat Mate C3000 Automatic Dry Food Feeder
strengths: Portion-controlled meals
Battery powered
Simple digital timer
Dishwasher-safe bowl

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
